bays.restriction: On-street pay-by-phone bays (PayByPhone location 805648) — first hour free, session must be booked
bays.times: Pay-by-phone bay charging hours are shown on the bay signs; the council's location table does not publish per-location hours. Maximum stay 4 hours, no return within 2 hours (council 'Where you can park' page)
bays.tariff: District Onstreet tariff (tariff code TC2). First hour FREE — the free session must still be booked through PayByPhone, one free hour per location per day. Then by CO2 band: up to 2 hours £2.20 (0-100 g/km) rising to £2.90 (over 256 g/km); up to 4 hours £3.50 rising to £4.60. Pre-Euro-6 diesel surcharges apply (+20p to +£1.10 by period). Motorcycles £3.00 flat up to 4 hours. (London Gazette notice 4863677, Schedule 5; charges from May 2025)
